name: Devoto
description: Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store. Sells groceries, beverages, household and personal care, appliances, technology and toys. Online orders deliver within the store's published delivery zones; the homepage refers prices to the delivery area without naming it.
description_es: Cadena de supermercados de Uruguay con tienda online. Vende comestibles, bebidas, limpieza y cuidado personal, electrodomésticos, tecnología y juguetes. Los pedidos online se entregan dentro de las zonas de entrega publicadas; la página principal remite los precios al área de entrega sin nombrarla.

ships_to.notes: Online delivery within published delivery zones only; the zones are not listed on the homepage.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Links to pickup orders and branches; details not read.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.
